suggestions: I'm grateful for the quiet moments right before Fajr when the world feels still and peaceful.
I'm thankful for finally tracking down and fixing that stubborn bug after hours of debugging.
I'm grateful for a hot, frothy cup of teh tarik to recharge during a long afternoon.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a stable job that allows me to support myself and share with my family.
I'm grateful for a smooth production deployment with zero breaking changes or unexpected errors.
I'm thankful for the cool breeze and cozy atmosphere when afternoon rain breaks the humid heat.
I'm grateful for a teammate who took the time to leave a genuinely helpful and kind code review.
I'm thankful for accessible, clean prayer spaces at the office that offer a quiet mental break during the workday.
I'm grateful for late-night mamak catch-ups with close friends where we can just laugh and decompress.
I'm thankful for a reliable dual-monitor setup that makes my daily workflow feel so much smoother.
I'm grateful for my family's warm home-cooked meals whenever I visit them over the weekend.
I'm thankful for that rare, satisfying feeling when all unit test cases pass on the very first try.
I'm grateful for catching the LRT right as the doors open, making my commute effortless.
I'm thankful for clear, well-written documentation that saved me hours of guessing.
I'm grateful for the blessing of good health and peace of mind to navigate life's daily challenges.
